dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to characterize the spatio-temporal variations in fraction of Photosynthetically Active Radiation (fPAR) values of different vegetation types, for the purpose of correlating fPAR values with the Vegetation Indices derived from satellite data. fPAR values were determined in 70 plots situated along 14 transects used to characterize the spatial variation in fPAR, as well as in 5 plots used to characterize the temporal variation in fPAR.
